basis: The root negates one property. It does not negate a composite or assert an additional property.
children: Earth has no rings.
scoped_obligations: Negation is internal to the single rings property: Earth has no rings.

basis: Slowly and the opposite direction modify one spinning relation. In this close qualification case I retain both modifiers within that relation; the sentence does not separately coordinate a second property or event.
children: Venus spins slowly in the opposite direction from most planets.
scoped_obligations: Keep Venus as the spinning subject, slowly as the manner qualifier, and the opposite-direction comparison with most planets.

basis: This is one angle-of-tilt relation with its reference plane and orbital referent.
children: Mars' axis of rotation is tilted 25 degrees with respect to the plane of its orbit around the Sun.
scoped_obligations: Preserve 25 degrees, the plane of Mars' orbit, and the Sun as stated; do not replace the reference plane or fact check the angle.

basis: A superlative comparison is one relation. Other planets are comparison arguments, not separately asserted facts.
children: Jupiter has the shortest day in the solar system.
scoped_obligations: The comparison domain is the solar system and the superlative is shortest day.

basis: One measurement event carries quantity, unit, time, and location qualifiers; none is a separately coordinated event.
children: The probe measured 12 kPa during 2024 in Ontario.
scoped_obligations: Preserve the probe as measurer, 12 kPa as the measured quantity, during 2024 as the temporal qualifier, and Ontario as the location.

basis: The root asserts one comparison activity. It gives no independently asserted temperature values.
children: The analyst compared the temperature in Oslo with the temperature in Rome.
scoped_obligations: The analyst is the comparing agent; the temperature in Oslo and the temperature in Rome are the comparison arguments.

basis: Two independently evaluable properties of Venus are explicitly coordinated.
children: Venus is the second planet from the Sun.
Venus is Earth's closest planetary neighbor.
scoped_obligations: Preserve both the ordinal relation to the Sun and the closest-neighbor relation to Earth.

basis: The root independently asserts a size comparison and an orbital-distance comparison. The second comparative baseline is recovered from the sentence itself, without source-locator context.
children: Deimos is about half as big as Phobos.
Deimos orbits two and a half times farther away from Mars than Phobos does.
scoped_obligations: About qualifies the size comparison.
Preserve the expression two and a half times farther away without converting it into a new mathematical ratio.
Phobos supplies the elided baseline of the second comparison through the coordinated comparison construction; Mars is the orbital reference.

basis: Two tilt properties are independently asserted, and the controlled profile makes the leading temporal modifier shared.
children: During part of the year, the northern hemisphere is tilted toward the Sun.
During part of the year, the southern hemisphere is tilted away from the Sun.
scoped_obligations: The explicit leading temporal modifier has shared scope; both tilts hold during the same described part of the year.
Resolve away to away from the Sun using the coordinated root. Do not add a planet identity from the URL.

basis: The climate effect, weather effect, and shielding property can be independently evaluated. The coordinated effect targets express separate assertions, while their temporal modifiers remain attached.
children: Earth's atmosphere affects Earth's long-term climate.
Earth's atmosphere affects Earth's short-term local weather.
Earth's atmosphere shields people on Earth from much of the harmful radiation coming from the Sun.
scoped_obligations: The authorized context identifies the atmosphere as Earth's and us as people on Earth.
Preserve long-term for climate, short-term and local for weather, and much of for the harmful solar radiation.

basis: The explicit that-complement contains coordinated propositions. The guideline requires the reporting attribution on each child.
children: The auditor reported that the server stopped.
The auditor reported that the alarm sounded.
scoped_obligations: Both complements remain attributed to the auditor and within the same reported coordinated complement.
The root does not independently endorse either event as an unattributed fact or require two distinct report events.

basis: Two independent events are coordinated, with shared leading scope under the controlled profile.
children: In Ontario during 2024, the laboratory measured 12 kPa.
In Ontario during 2024, the operator recorded 4 kg.
scoped_obligations: The explicit leading jurisdictional/location and temporal modifiers apply to both events.
Preserve laboratory versus operator roles, measured versus recorded predicates, and 12 kPa versus 4 kg quantities.

children: The auditor reported that the server stopped.
The auditor reported that the alarm sounded.
alternatives.scope: Both events are within the auditor's reported complement; they are not independently endorsed.

children: The auditor reported that the server stopped.
The alarm sounded.
alternatives.scope: Only the stopping is within the auditor's report; sounding is asserted by the root outside that report.

basis: Without an explicit that boundary, coordination can stay inside the reported complement or join the reporting clause to an independently asserted alarm event.
scoped_obligations: Keep auditor reporting attached to every proposition it scopes over.
Do not settle complement versus matrix coordination using the missing comma or ordinary frequency.

children: The operator inspected the valve.
The engineer recorded the pressure in Ontario.
alternatives.scope: Ontario modifies the pressure-recording event only; the inspection location is unspecified.

children: The operator inspected the valve in Ontario.
The engineer recorded the pressure in Ontario.

basis: The trailing location phrase can attach locally to the second conjunct or to the coordinated events. The guideline does not let punctuation decide trailing-adjunct scope.
scoped_obligations: Preserve Ontario wherever the trailing adjunct scopes; neither interpretation supplies a time.

alternatives.scope: With the camera is an instrumental modifier of photographing.
alternatives.text: The technician photographed the researcher using the camera.

alternatives.scope: With the camera identifies or qualifies the researcher; the photographic instrument is unspecified.
alternatives.text: The technician photographed the researcher who was with the camera.

basis: The camera phrase can be an event instrument or a modifier of the researcher. Neither reading is forced by the authorized context.
scoped_obligations: Keep the technician as the photographing agent and the researcher as the photographed subject.

children: The old technicians arrived.
The operators arrived.
alternatives.scope: Old modifies technicians only; operators' ages are unspecified.

children: The old technicians arrived.
The old operators arrived.

basis: The adjective can scope over the first noun or the coordinated noun phrase. The guideline does not syntactically define explicit leading shared modifier; I apply that convention to overtly shared fronted adjuncts, leaving this noun-phrase attachment ambiguous.
scoped_obligations: Both technicians and operators arrived.

Treat old within the coordinated subject as an attachment ambiguity, not an overtly shared fronted clause-level adjunct. This application of the leading-modifier rule is a declared guideline interpretation.

alternatives.scope: The report may differ by researcher.
alternatives.structure: For every researcher r, there exists a report p such that r reviewed p.

alternatives.scope: One report is shared across all researchers.
alternatives.structure: There exists a report p such that every researcher r reviewed p.

basis: Universal and existential quantifiers admit different relative scope, producing materially different review relations.
scoped_obligations: Every retains universal scope over researchers. A report supplies existential report scope, without an exactly-one claim.

alternatives.text: The operator told the engineer that the operator had signed the report.
The operator told the engineer that the engineer had signed the report.

basis: Either supplied female referent can resolve she, and the root and context do not choose between them.
scoped_obligations: The authorized context supplies two women: the operator and the engineer.
Retain the signing proposition within what the operator told the engineer; do not independently assert signing.

basis: The scale analogy is explicitly conditional. Flat all_of would incorrectly endorse its antecedent and consequent as independent facts.
scoped_obligations: Counterfactual if_then(antecedent: the Sun were as tall as a typical front door; consequent: Earth would be the size of a nickel).
Preserve the typical-front-door comparison and conditional would modality. Neither branch is asserted as an actual size.

basis: An explicit counterfactual condition relates the two sizes; it requires a conditional operator.
scoped_obligations: Counterfactual if_then(antecedent: Earth were the size of a nickel; consequent: Mars would be about as big as a raspberry).
Preserve about and would, and do not assert either branch individually.

basis: The root asserts a conditional scale relation, requiring an operator beyond flat conjunction.
scoped_obligations: Counterfactual if_then(antecedent: Earth were the size of a grape; consequent: Jupiter would be about as big as a basketball).
Preserve about and would, and do not assert either branch individually.

operands.text: Phobos is slowly moving towards Mars.

operands: Phobos will crash into Mars in about 50 million years.
Phobos will break apart in about 50 million years.

alternatives.scope: The trailing time phrase has shared scope over both predicted outcomes.

operands.text: Phobos is slowly moving towards Mars.

operands: Phobos will break apart in about 50 million years.

alternatives.scope: The trailing time phrase modifies break apart only; the crash time is unspecified.

basis: Current movement is conjoined with an alternative future outcome. The trailing time phrase can attach to the local break-apart predicate or the future disjunction. The guideline requires retaining ambiguity when ambiguity and representation beyond flat all_of both apply.
scoped_obligations: Authorized context resolves it to Phobos and the planet to Mars.
Preserve slowly for current movement, will for the predicted alternative outcomes, and about for the 50-million-year quantity.
Both live interpretations require nested all_of and any_of. Record representation beyond flat all_of in addition to temporal-scope ambiguity.
The disjunctive outcomes are alternatives, not separately endorsed events.

basis: The explicit or requires a disjunctive operator and cannot be flattened into all_of.
scoped_obligations: any_of(the valve is open; the pump is running). The root asserts the disjunction, not either branch individually.
Do not add an exclusive-only condition; the root does not specify exactly one branch.

basis: It is not true that negates the whole conjunction. This scoped negation requires an operator beyond flat all_of.
scoped_obligations: not(all_of(the server stopped; the alarm sounded)). Negation scopes over the coordinated proposition.
Do not replace it with all_of(the server did not stop; the alarm did not sound), or assert any negative branch individually.
